silhouette.reason: Unmistakably a brown bear from every view: shoulder hump, dished face, round ears, heavy plantigrade forelegs, short tail; the side view in sheet.png matches the classic standing-bear outline.
fixes: raise the shoulder hump 3–4 cm in the concept/mesh chain so it reads more sharply against the back line in SIDE

proportions.reason: 1.7 × 0.6 × 1.0 m on the grid matches the sourced average adult (1.7 m head and body, 1.0 m shoulder). Head-to-body and leg lengths look right beside photos; the ears are slightly large.
fixes: scale the ears ~15% down in a Blender step (steps.ts) — they read cub-sized against the head

materials.reason: The image-to-3D texture reads as fur with darker legs and a grizzled back; claws separate. But lighting is baked into the albedo (a bright shoulder patch, white-capped ears that look sunlit from every angle) and the fur has one uniform roughness.
fixes: de-light the albedo before import (a Blender bake step that divides out the baked AO/sun)
repaint the ear tips to the body brown; they read as white caps

detail.reason: Fur breakup, face features and claws come from the texture and hold at third-person distance; geometry is smooth (no fur clumps on the outline, claws painted rather than modelled).
fixes: a strand/shell pass on the back and belly fringe so the outline breaks into fur clumps
model claws as short curved cones on each paw (code parts on the paw bones)

wear.reason: Darker, dirtier legs and a grizzled back give some story, but there is no mud, no wet fur, no scars or rubbed patches.
fixes: mud on the paws and lower legs (grime with the ground mask over the textured part)
a few seeded scars and a rubbed patch on the shoulder

lod.reason: LOD2 (5k) is nearly indistinguishable from LOD0 at the sheet's far distance: same outline and colour blocks.
fixes: drop LOD2 to ~3k: the far view does not need 5k for a 1.7 m animal, which would pay for detail at LOD0

technical.reason: QA PASS; 30k / 10k / 5k triangles; one draw per LOD; skinned to the sourced skeleton with idle, look and walk clips.
fixes: spend the LOD2 savings on the face at LOD0 (eye sockets, lips) where the hero looks
